description: Use before a release to review 1-3 public pinned package versions together. Pass packages as an array of {ecosystem, package_name, version}; ecosystem must be npm or PyPI and version must be exact, not a range. Returns a consolidated review decision and source completeness. Free beta; never auto-upgrades. Use dependency_preflight for a single-package comparison.

packages.description: Select 1-3 public exact versions explicitly; no lockfile upload or automatic transitive scan.

ecosystem.description: Case-sensitive registry ecosystem: npm or PyPI.

package_name.description: Public registry name, e.g. lodash, @scope/name or requests.

version.description: Exact installed release such as 4.17.21; never latest, a range or a URL.

name: release_gate
